reply_text:
I answered Tobias in a thread reply on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api. The depot was **Southgate**.

- **Where it came from:** Priyanka posted in that channel during the carrier API outage on 2025-09-03. She said label printing stalled at the Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. Her closing update said Southgate had cleared the backlog. Tobias is a member of that channel, so this is all information he can see himself.
- **No address:** neither the channel nor the files he can access give a street address for the site, only the name. I told him that in the reply.
